verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is a full accounting system, so a month-end close checklist is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence documents continuous automatic reconciliation, a choice of accrual accounting, and accountant invites with transaction comments. However, nothing shows a close checklist or workflow that tracks reconciliation status, accrual entries, or reviewer sign-offs. These adjacent features do not amount to the checklist-driven close the story describes.
